continue_transect: Continue transect or start new one?
email_dialog_title: Enter email address to send track data
clear_map_ends_transect: This will finish the active transect. Continue?
unfinished_transect: You have an unfinished transect started {}. Continue it or finish it?
location_permission_content:
{app} needs your location to track your route and record where you find species.

We will first ask for regular location access, and then we will need "Allow all the time" permission to keep tracking even when the app is in the background or your screen is locked. Please allow both to make sure your transects are stored properly.
location_permission_content_ios:
{app} needs your location to track your route and record where you find species.

Please choose "Allow While Using App" in the next step. If iOS later asks to change the access to "Always Allow", please accept it so tracking can continue even when your screen is locked.
about_description: Universal application for field data collection.
point_nearby_content: There is an existing point within {}m. Do you want to add the species to the existing point or create a new one?
photo_gallery_failed: Photo saved to the record, but not to the gallery
delete_photos_hint: Photos taken with the app stay in the {app} gallery album. Photos that arrived through an import or a restore do not.
location_background_content:
To keep recording your transect while the app is in the background or your screen is locked, {app} needs the "Allow all the time" location setting.

Android asks for this separately: on the next screen choose "Allow all the time". Without it the route stops being recorded as soon as you leave the app.
location_background_denied:
Background location is still not allowed, so the route will only be recorded while the app is open on screen.

You can turn it on in the app settings: Permissions → Location → "Allow all the time".
location_permission_required: Recording a transect needs access to your location. Allow it to start.
location_permission_denied_forever:
Location access is turned off for {app}, so a transect cannot be recorded.

You can turn it on in the app settings: Permissions → Location.
precise_location_required:
{app} needs precise location to record the route and the records. Approximate location is not enough.

In the app settings, under Permissions → Location, turn on "Use precise location".
no_points_save_prompt: No points have been recorded. Do you want to save the transect?
delete_transect_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete this transect?
delete_point_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete this point?
delete_record_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete this record?
